instruction: Oops, I deleted the party night poster by mistake. Can you undo this and put it back on my Desktop?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

result.command: [ -f /home/user/Desktop/poster_party_night.webp ] && echo 'File exists.' || echo 'File does not exist.'

metadata.explanation: Undo deletion task using informal language. Evaluator validates successful file recovery to Desktop location.
